title: Overview
subtitle: Learn what TaraHive is and the purpose behind the application.

blocks.text: TaraHive is an all-in-one travel planning platform designed to simplify the way individuals and groups organize trips. It combines itinerary planning, collaboration, weather information, AI-powered assistance, budgeting, and safety tools into a single application.
Our mission is to make travel planning more organized, collaborative, and accessible. TaraHive helps travelers spend less time managing details and more time enjoying their journeys.
TaraHive continuously evolves through updates and user feedback to improve the travel planning experience.
